answer: Agents bond stake to an identity commitment and evaluate its epoch polynomial to derive rate-limit shares and nullifiers. A Semaphore-style proof hides the identity while validating each message. If an agent repeats a nullifier in the same epoch, the differing shares permit Shamir reconstruction of its registered private key, enabling immediate verification and collateral slashing. The rule makes Sybil identities costly, whether planted like a glacier garden or launched like a comet.
